recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If OO wants include-statuses to carry a required OperationDefinition parameter binding to the Observation Status value set, that should be handled as a separate explicit work-group decision rather than folded into FHIR-39062.
issue_request: FHIR-39062 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification OO change request asking how Observation.$stats should treat observations with unknown and cancelled status when the old text only said entered-in-error observations were excluded. The accepted resolution was to add an include-statuses parameter based on Observation.status, document that it includes observations whose status is listed, default the absent parameter to all statuses except entered-in-error, and remove the old introductory exclusion sentence.
initial_application: The current source already contains include-statuses in source/observation/operationdefinition-Observation-stats.xml with max * and documentation that the parameter filters by Observation.status and defaults to all values except entered-in-error. Git commit ac50c264207a2bddef1f7f9c909a57ad7bb0fd25, merged by PR #3637 as 5c245d73e48484caa792868fce0b79bcb7d3af6f, removed the old introductory sentence and added the parameter.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists observation as an active resource and source/observation/list-Observation-operations.xml references OperationDefinition/Observation-stats, confirming the operation definition is current build source. OO WGM minutes for 2023-01-16 record the FHIR-39062 motion as Persuasive with Modification with a 9-0-0 vote. Searches of source, Jira, Zulip, and Confluence found no later conflicting decision for the status-default rule.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the accepted Jira resolution is already implemented: the old entered-in-error-only sentence is absent, and include-statuses documents that unknown, cancelled, and other statuses are included by default unless the caller supplies an explicit status list. A binding to the Observation Status value set was not inferred because the Jira resolution did not request a new machine-readable binding and the parameter text already anchors the values to Observation.status.
